beforeRecord.q: A matching service shortens unemployment spells among otherwise qualified job seekers. At the same time, an industry closes permanently and displaced workers need new qualifications. Which conclusion is defensible?
options: Frictional falls, structural is unchanged; their net natural-rate effect is downward.

beforeRecord.commonError: Incorrectly concludes “The matching service changes cyclical unemployment and the closure changes only measured participation” in this unemployment types task.
